searched: The files: every file in this build. Our own index.html, js/*.js and the assets written by our own scripts in DrownedCity/Pipeline (Blender and numpy, seeded); assets/hero.glb, assets/reaver.glb and assets/ember.glb start from two Microsoft Rocketbox avatars, changed by our scripts; vendor/three. Rocketbox's licence file is carried in licenses/.
mine: The game's code, rules, shaders, HUD and all its sound (Web Audio, no sound files); the world of Thalor: its seabed, coral, kelp, rock, ruins, statue, arena, shrines and bells; the whale, sharks, rays, turtles, jellies, fish, dolphins and the Leviathan (modelled by our Blender scripts); the Warden's armour, trident and mantle, the Reavers' armour and spears, and every swim and fight move, with the walk and run taken from the Rocketbox motion named below (keyed by our Python scripts). The Warden and Thalor are original: not a comic-book character, not a famous game.

others.what: three.js r185, the 3D library, carried in vendor/three
meshoptimizer's decoder, which unpacks the compressed models, carried in vendor/three/examples/jsm/libs

The Warden's body and face, changed and dressed by us in assets/hero.glb and assets/hero_phone.glb: Microsoft Rocketbox avatar Sports_Male_01. The Reavers' bodies, changed in assets/reaver.glb and assets/reaver_phone.glb, and the Emberkin's, reshaped in assets/ember.glb: avatar Military_Male_02
NotesMosaic port kit (mosa-port.js): saves that follow the player to another device

The Warden's walk, jog, run, sprint and standing motion, and his upper body treading water, in assets/hero.glb and assets/hero_phone.glb: Microsoft Rocketbox animations m_walk_neutral_01, m_run_neutral_01, m_run_fast_01, m_idle_neutral_01, m_run_start, m_run_stop, m_walk_start, m_walk_stop

The Warden's swimming in assets/hero.glb and assets/hero_phone.glb: motion capture of a front crawl, trial 126_02. The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.
others.terms: The FAQ at mocap.cs.cmu.edu/faqs.php, read 1 Nov 2026: "The motion capture data may be copied, modified, or redistributed without permission." It asks that the data be credited, as the line above does

others.what: The player's flight spring and the body's turn in js/hero.js: spring_character_update and simple_spring_damper_exact_quat, written out from the author's published page
The method of the turbine jet in js/turbine.js: a cone, a colour along it, noise run along it, an alpha from the view angle. Written new; the idea comes from this shader
The method of the flames in js/flame.js: noise times a mask, minus how far the flame has burnt away, then a hard edge. Written new; the idea comes from this shader
others.by: Stylized Fire 3D, godotshaders.com, after Minions Art
